title: Etale morphisms of algebraic spaces are locally quasi-finite
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $f:E\to T$ be a morphism to a scheme $T$ over $S$. Assume that $f$ is etale in the chartwise sense: for every representable etale morphism $V\to E$ with $V$ a scheme, the composite $V\to T$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then $f$ is locally quasi-finite in the chartwise sense: for every such $V\to E$, the composite $V\to T$ is locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite].

source.place: Tag 03XU (lemma-etale-locally-quasi-finite), using the scheme theorem that etale morphisms are locally quasi-finite.

proof.text: Fix any representable etale morphism $v:V\to E$ with $V$ a scheme, and write $g=f\circ v:V\to T$. The chartwise hypothesis on $f$ says that $g$ is etale. By [def-weil-etale-morphism], being etale includes being unramified, so $g$ is an unramified morphism of schemes. No surjectivity or quasi-compactness of this chart is needed.

source.place: Tag 02GK (lemma-etale-smooth-unramified), as used in Tag 03WS (lemma-etale-locally-quasi-finite); unramifiedness is also an explicit conjunct in def-weil-etale-morphism.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-unramified-quasi-finite-at-points] to the scheme morphism $g:V\to T$ from step 1. Its only extra hypothesis is unramifiedness, already established there. It follows that $g$ is quasi-finite at every point of $V$, equivalently locally quasi-finite.

source.place: Tag 02V5 (lemma-unramified-quasi-finite), the second input in the proof of Tag 03WS (lemma-etale-locally-quasi-finite).

proof.text: The morphism $v:V\to E$ was arbitrary among all the representable etale maps from schemes in the hypothesis. Therefore every such composite $V\to T$ is locally quasi-finite. This is exactly the chartwise conclusion stated in the item.

source.place: Tag 03XU (lemma-etale-locally-quasi-finite), final sentence: local quasi-finiteness follows by definition; here both chartwise quantifiers are explicit in the item.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03XU (lemma-etale-locally-quasi-finite), specialized to the item's explicit chartwise hypotheses, using Morphisms Tag 03WS and its proof via Tags 02GK and 02V5.
